Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000416" [constraint]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, indexer)
- memory_id "1000346" [constraint]: The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11, the full reindex)
- memory_id "1000156": The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000430": INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000664": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000682": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000615" [decision]: As of 2025-09-02, clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: feature-flags, clients)
- memory_id "1000675" [decision]: As of 2025-09-23, for anything Boreal-related, page Lena this cycle, not Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000687": Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000438" [decision]: Ledger service migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000395": The Cinder team observed that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder team, webhook dispatcher, the cache change)
- memory_id "1000604": Team Dune observed that the image resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: team Dune, image resizer, the runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000336": In the product catalog, joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000628": The Cinder team observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Cinder team, auth gateway, the runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000667": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000660": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000221": The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: ledger service, the cache change)
- memory_id "1000180": The job scheduler depends on feature-flags for per-job kill switches.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000434": The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: INC-2025-011, the schema migration)
- memory_id "1000169": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier)
